title: NCPatcher region catalog
description: The overlays a game has and how large each one may grow. Shared game knowledge: one catalog serves every project built against that game, and a target points at it with region-catalog.

regions.description: One entry per overlay. An entry nothing lands in is dropped rather than built.

dest.description: "main" for the ARM binary, or "ovNN" for an overlay.

address.description: Where the overlay is loaded in RAM.

maxsize.description: How far this overlay may grow before it runs into whatever the game placed after it. Exceeding it is an error, not a warning.

compress.description: Whether the overlay is stored compressed.
